name: flauz-production
description: Flauz production-readiness verification plane (A-PROD-005-W1): the runtime-installed-product census (flauz.production.census: the extension set the runtime actually loaded + the dist-tree manifests + the service-side parity/SBOM surfaces, verified against the repo-state product registry through the W5 product-root ports -- every expected extension present + parseable, no unexpected extension, parity coverage both directions over the installed set, SBOM component coverage, the built-in id/entrypoint laws; the typed verdict table green/tampered/torn per check class; where the runtime surface is absent the census degrades typed, never silently green; the record persisted workspace-locally + census-visible), the documented supported/unsupported capability matrix (flauz.production.matrix: every capability the product ships -- rows derived from the real registry surfaces, never a hardcoded list that can drift; unknown-to-the-matrix capabilities = typed disclosure; persisted machine-readable + rendered human-readable), and the production gate (flauz.production.gate: the one-command verdict binding the ELEVEN prove-items -- the items with existing surfaces evaluate from the real surfaces at runtime with their evidence pointers, the items needing new machinery are typed NOT-YET rows naming the owning later wave; GO-FOR-BETA / NOT-PRODUCTION-READY with the exact row-level truth, never a silently green aggregate).
